Metadata.title: Ape Kade — an online shop for every seller
Metadata.description: Turn your Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or WhatsApp page into an online shop with checkout, cash on delivery, waybills, receipts and order tracking.

HomePage.eyebrow: For sellers on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp
HomePage.title: Your shop, <accent>finally</accent> in one place.
HomePage.subtitle: Buyers choose their items, pick cash on delivery or bank transfer, and place the order themselves. Every order lands in one place, ready to pack and ship.
HomePage.trial: Free for 14 days. No card needed.

link.title: Your own shop link
link.body: Share {domain}/store/your-shop in your bio, posts and chats.

payments.title: Cash on delivery and bank transfer
payments.body: Buyers pay the way they already do. Card payments come later.

documents.title: Waybills and receipts
documents.body: Print a waybill with the COD amount and send a receipt in one tap.

tracking.title: Order tracking for buyers
tracking.body: Buyers follow their order with a link, so fewer "where is my parcel?" messages.

HomePage.footer: © Ape Kade · Made in Sri Lanka
